title: White Sauce (Béchamel)
description: A classic French white sauce — smooth, creamy, and versatile. The foundation of countless dishes.

method.instruction: Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add flour and whisk continuously for 1–2 minutes to cook out the raw flour taste. The roux should be pale golden, not browned.
Slowly add milk while whisking constantly to prevent lumps from forming.
Continue whisking over medium heat until the sauce thickens and becomes smooth, about 5–7 minutes.
Season with salt and white pepper. Use immediately or cover with plastic wrap pressed directly onto the surface to prevent a skin forming.

notes.title: Lump-Free Sauce
notes.content: Warm the milk before adding it to the roux for the smoothest result. Cold milk works but takes longer and requires more vigorous whisking.

notes.title: Uses
notes.content: The foundation for lasagne, gratins, creamy pasta dishes, and as a base for cheese sauce. Add grated cheese for an instant Mornay sauce.
